messages:
Alex K: Hey all — first day here! Quick provisioning snag: clicked the Okta invite and got 'invite token invalid'. Tried re-requesting the invite but nothing landed. Also trying to enroll a passkey on my Win11 machine (Edge) and the browser just shows a generic "error enrolling passkey". Finally, 1Password shows no seat for me. Who should I ping to get temporary access?

Jamie (IT): Welcome, Alex — congrats! Can you confirm the exact email the invite was sent to (including alias)? sometimes invites go to alex+k@example.com vs alex@. Also check spam/promotions.

Alex K: The invite email came to alex.k@redwood.dev (that’s my Google Workspace). I checked spam. The link looks like: https://redwood.okta.com/invite?token=... (shows "Invite token invalid (1001)").

Jamie (IT): Thanks. Two quick tries: 1) open the invite in an incognito window or different browser (Chrome) — Edge on corp policy sometimes blocks the flow. 2) If passkey enrollment fails on Win/Edge, try the Okta Verify mobile app or use a security key (YubiKey) if you have one. If neither works I’ll create a temporary SAML session for you.

Samir (Platform): FYI our Windows image blocks FIDO/WebAuthN when SmartScreen / enterprise cert chain is missing — the behavior you're seeing matches that. If Alex can try on personal phone (iOS/Android) using passkey there’s a decent chance it will succeed and then Okta will persist the credential.

Emily - People Ops: I also checked seats — 1Password provisioning was delayed for a handful of hires this morning. I opened a license request (PL-998) and pinged the vendor. In the meantime, we can add you to the "new-hires-temp" Google group so you get calendar invites and docs access. Do you need any immediate repo access?

Alex K: Thanks. Yes please add to new-hires-temp. Repo access not urgent yet. I can try mobile. If the invite link is stale, can you reissue?

Jamie (IT): Reissuing now. I created ticket IT-51234 and resent a fresh invite to alex.k@redwood.dev. If that fails, DM me and I'll whitelist your device and attach a 24-hour bypass token.

onboard-bot: [automated] Ticket created: IT-51234 — Okta invite reissue & passkey troubleshooting. Assigned to Jamie (IT). ETA 2h.

Alex K: Got the new invite email and the mobile passkey enrollment worked (used Okta Verify on my phone). I can sign in now. 1Password still shows no seat but I got the Google group invite — thanks!

Jamie (IT): Awesome. I'll follow up on 1Password with Emily. If you hit anything else, drop a note here or DM me. :wave:

Emily - People Ops: 1Password seat approved — vendor confirmed. You should see access in ~30 mins. Welcome aboard again! :tada:
